title: Scalar compatibility of the open projection and pullback compositor
statement: Let A and B be commutative rings, φ:A→B a unital map, and D_R(T) the ordinary unbounded derived category of constant R-module sheaves on the small etale site of a scheme T [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Write Q_T for scalar extension, δ_T for its normalized tensor comparison [def-pur-exceptional-coefficient-normalizations], L_R(p) for geometric derived pullback, a_p:Q_Y;L_B(p)≅L_A(p);Q_X for scalarPullbackIso, and χ_p for its counit mate scalarMate [lem-pur-etale-scalar-mate-projection]. Semicolon composes in application order. Put τ_p(K,E)=δ_X(L_A(p)K,E);(a_p(K)⁻¹⊗id), a map Q_X(L_A(p)K⊗E)→L_B(p)Q_YK⊗Q_XE. Let c=(j:X↪Z,p:Z→Y) be a compactification of f:X→Y [def-asd-compactifiable]. Write J_R=j_!, β_j:Q_Z;J_A≅J_B;Q_X for the normalized open scalar map, and ω_R(c;K,M):L_R(p)K⊗J_R M→J_R(L_R(f)K⊗M) for the inverse signed swap, the inverse canonical open projection, J_R of tensoring with the pullback compositor L_R(j)L_R(p)≅L_R(f), and J_R of the final signed swap [lem-pur-etale-open-derived-tensor, lem-kun-tensor-sym]. This is precisely compactOpenProjection; β_j is ExceptionalCoefficients.openIso. For every K∈D_A(Y), M∈D_A(X), Q_Z(ω_A(c;K,M));β_j(L_A(f)K⊗M);J_B(τ_f(K,M)) = τ_p(K,J_AM);(id⊗β_j(M));ω_B(c;Q_YK,Q_XM). No coefficient finiteness, flatness, boundedness or additional geometric hypotheses occur.

proof.text: Factor compactOpenProjection as orderedOpenProjection at Lg*K followed by open extension of tensoring the canonical compactification pullback compositor in the first variable. This is naturality of the signed tensor symmetry. Apply the local scalar/open square at Lg*K and M.

Transport scalarPullback_composition from exact inverse image to left-derived inverse image. Expand the derived compositors as the exact compositors conjugated by leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory; naturality and inverse cancellation give Q of the compactification compositor followed by inverse scalarPullbackIso for f equals inverse scalarPullbackIso for j, Lj* of inverse scalarPullbackIso for g, and the B-compositor. This argument is written out in scalarPullback_compactification.

Use naturality of the scalar/open comparison to move Q of the tensor compositor through the open coefficient map, and naturality of tensorIso in its first variable to move it through the tensor comparison. Substitute the pullback-compositor scalar identity from the previous step. Paste the local square with this identity. Naturality of orderedOpenProjection in its ambient derived input and naturality of the curried tensor functor move inverse scalarPullbackIso for g to the source. Functoriality and associativity give exactly the stated equality.

theorem etaleOpenScalarProjection
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (φ : A →+* B)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} (c : Compactification f)
    (K : DerivedCategoryModule A Y) (M : DerivedCategoryModule A X) :
    (scalarExtension φ c.Z).map (compactOpenProjection A c K M) ≫
      (ExceptionalCoefficients.openIso φ c.i).hom.app
        (((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).obj
          ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).leftDerivedFunctor.obj K)).obj M) ≫
      (openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) c.i).mapDerivedCategory.map
        ((ExceptionalCoefficients.tensorIso φ X).hom.app
            ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).leftDerivedFunctor.obj K, M) ≫
          ((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) X).map
            ((scalarPullbackIso φ f).inv.app K)).app ((scalarExtension φ X).obj M)) =
    (ExceptionalCoefficients.tensorIso φ c.Z).hom.app
        ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g).leftDerivedFunctor.obj K,
          (openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.i).mapDerivedCategory.obj M) ≫
      ((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) c.Z).map
        ((scalarPullbackIso φ c.g).inv.app K)).app
          ((scalarExtension φ c.Z).obj
            ((openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.i).mapDerivedCategory.obj M)) ≫
      ((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) c.Z).obj
        ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) c.g).leftDerivedFunctor.obj
          ((scalarExtension φ Y).obj K))).map
            ((ExceptionalCoefficients.openIso φ c.i).hom.app M) ≫
      compactOpenProjection B c ((scalarExtension φ Y).obj K)
        ((scalarExtension φ X).obj M)
